headline: High-risk data leakage and cascading-error risks: Dexter’s broad egress plus Perplexity’s vendor-hosted browsing can expose financial data and amplify unverified outputs.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Dexter can write to .dexter/scratchpad and uses autonomous execution, while Perplexity runs vendor-hosted browsing and can ingest uploaded documents. A shared manual bridge or copied content could let attacker-controlled text influence downstream prompts, but no direct shared channel is documented, so I choose medium over low due to uncertainty.
conditions: IF Dexter scratchpad content is copied into Perplexity prompts or uploads
IF Perplexity output is pasted back into Dexter without sanitization
mitigations: Keep a strict human review step before copying text between agents
Use a fixed prompt template that strips instructions from pasted content
Separate scratchpad notes from any prompt-facing text
Disable automatic ingestion of uploaded documents unless reviewed
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: Dexter touches financial and market data and has broad network egress plus multiple API keys; Perplexity is vendor-hosted and sends queries/documents to api.perplexity.ai and search providers. If the same sensitive material is routed through both, leakage to third parties is plausible by default, and the blast radius includes financial data exposure.
conditions: IF financial or market data from Dexter is included in Perplexity queries or uploads
IF Dexter API-key-bearing context is forwarded into Perplexity browsing context
mitigations: Redact secrets and identifiers before any handoff
Restrict Perplexity inputs to non-sensitive summaries
Use separate accounts and API keys for each agent
Turn off upload of source documents containing financial data
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on cross-agent transfers

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Dexter supports multiple instances and broad egress, while Perplexity supports multiple instances but cannot write files, modify git state, or execute shell. The pair lacks overlapping destructive write surfaces, so direct capability conflict is limited to read/write coordination issues rather than shared mutable state.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same external API quota or rate-limited service
IF Dexter and Perplexity are manually coordinated on the same mutable dataset
mitigations: Assign separate work queues per agent
Stagger runs to avoid API throttling
Keep Perplexity read-only for shared artifacts
Avoid using both agents on the same mutable repository
requires-engineering: add resource locking for shared external services

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity is a search-RAG answer engine with live web search and citations, and Dexter is autonomous execution-oriented. If Dexter-generated facts are fed into Perplexity or Perplexity summaries are fed back into Dexter without verification, errors can cascade into downstream actions. The interaction is plausible but not directly documented, so medium fits.
conditions: IF Dexter outputs are treated as authoritative inputs to Perplexity
IF Perplexity summaries are used by Dexter without a verification step
mitigations: Require source checks before any handoff
Compare outputs against primary sources manually
Limit Dexter to drafting, not acting, on Perplexity-derived claims
Mark uncertain claims explicitly in both workflows
requires-engineering: add automated fact-verification gates

E_compliance.rationale: Dexter explicitly touches financial data and market data, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted and uploads documents/browsing context to its backend. If regulated financial or personal data is routed from Dexter into Perplexity, retention and residency obligations may diverge. The profiles do not prove a specific legal mismatch, so medium is the cautious choice.
conditions: IF regulated financial records or personal data are sent from Dexter to Perplexity
IF the deployment requires a retention policy shorter than Perplexity’s default handling
mitigations: Avoid sending regulated records to Perplexity
Use anonymized or synthetic examples only
Review vendor retention and residency settings before use
Keep a local audit log of cross-agent transfers
requires-engineering: implement policy-based data routing
